coordinate_system: Relative to task-specific anchors; x east, y up, z south. Different structures have distinct non-overlapping anchors.
state_matching: Only listed state keys are required. Age ranges accept any value in range. Unlisted states are ignored. Air cells are required empty.
extra_constraints: Door must be operable with a clear external entry.
Furnished house must have a two-block-high walkable route from south entry to center.
Pen has four-block interior headroom and a full floor; marked terrain supplies its floor.
Do not change blocks outside authorized build/harvest regions.
